question: How do I create an account?
answer: To create an account, click on the 'Sign Up' button at the top right corner and fill in your details.

question: Is there a free trial available?
answer: Yes, we offer a 7-day free trial for all new users to explore our premium courses.

question: How can I reset my password?
answer: Click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page, and we will send a reset link to your registered email.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and Apple Pay.

question: Can I download courses for offline viewing?
answer: Yes, you can download course videos on our mobile app for offline access.

question: How do I get a certificate of completion?
answer: Once you complete all the lessons and assignments in a course, your certificate will be automatically generated in your profile.

question: Are the courses self-paced?
answer: Yes, all our courses are self-paced, so you can learn at your own convenience.

question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
answer: We offer a full refund within 30 days of purchase if you have not completed more than 20% of the course.

question: Do you offer student discounts?
answer: Yes, students with a valid .edu email address can get a 50% discount on all subscriptions.

question: How can I contact technical support?
answer: You can reach our support team via email at support@example.com or through the live chat on our website.

question: Is there a mobile app available?
answer: Yes, our app is available for both iOS and Android devices.

question: Can I share my account with others?
answer: No, account sharing is against our terms of service. Each subscription is for a single user.

question: How long do I have access to a course?
answer: Once you purchase a course, you have lifetime access to its content.

question: What are the system requirements for the courses?
answer: You only need a modern web browser and a stable internet connection to access our platform.

question: Are there any prerequisites for the beginner courses?
answer: No, our beginner courses are designed for people with no prior knowledge in the subject.

question: Can I switch from a monthly to an annual plan?
answer: Yes, you can upgrade to an annual plan anytime from your account settings.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time under the 'Billing' section in your account settings.

question: Are captions available for the videos?
answer: Yes, most of our courses include English captions, and we are working on adding more languages.

question: Can I interact with the instructors?
answer: Yes, each course has a dedicated Q&A section where you can ask questions and interact with instructors.

question: Do you offer corporate training?
answer: Yes, we have special plans for teams and organizations. Please contact our sales team for more information.

question: Very Bad Service
answer: We apologize for any inconvenience. Please contact our support team so we can assist you further.
